intent: Give power users a keyboard-first, searchable palette of actions/destinations (⌘K-style).
avoid_when: the action set is small enough for a regular dropdown or visible toolbar
a11y_contract: the dialog and search field ship default aria-labels ("Command menu", "Search"); the results listbox defaults to aria-label "Suggestions" unless the caller supplies aria-label/aria-labelledby
requires_data: a searchable list of items with label and action; typically opened via a global keyboard shortcut the host app wires up
